name: cv-sheet
description: Real CV content laid onto landscape sheets (842 x 599) in the Figma CV style: serif section headings, light sans body, a year column, a footer with the page number. Preview layout only: greedy fill by measured height, not an export engine.

props.name: blocks
props.description: [{kind: "heading" | "text", text}]. A text block starting with YYYY<TAB> is a dated row; a year is drawn once for consecutive rows of the same year on a sheet. With opts.editable, blocks are dragged only among the blocks of the same year of the same section.

props.name: title
props.description: The big title at the top of the first sheet (Figma: CURRICULUM VITAE).

rationale: Read off Figma section CV (frames 328:19147 cover, 328:19319 inner): sheet 842 x 599, 50px side margins, 42px top, 50px footer; Bodoni Moda Bold 28/34 and 20, Karla Light 10/12.7 and 12, black on white; year column 24px with a 16px gap. Type roles have no dis-system tokens yet (dis-system is Inter throughout), so they are component custom properties at the top of style.css, ready to move into tokens/*.json. Font files are not in the repo: the stacks fall back to a serif and Inter. Colors use existing tokens (text-active, object-white-passive, base-0 in light). Dark theme (2026-10-19, explicit request): the sheet stays paper, a muted white (base-100) with black text (base-1000) from the palette primitives. Staged in local-components until the maintainer confirms it goes into dis-system. In place (clickToEdit, explicit request 2026-10-24): the look of portfolio-sheet's texts edited in place, so both previews edit alike: a dotted edge and the text cursor on hover, an accent edge round the block while editing, the paper behind, edges 1px / 2px on screen at any zoom.
a11y_notes: Sheets are a visual preview of the document; headings are real h2/h3 elements and block text is set as text, never as markup. The page footer is decoration of the preview.
